lastCompletedStory.title: Plumb configured from through sidecar escalation call sites

nextStoryContext: All 7 sendEscalation call sites in src/commands/sidecar.ts (buildShipEscalateFn, buildToolchainEscalateFn, drain closure via makeProductionDrainNotifyFn, makeProductionEscalateFn, blockedCycleEscalateFn, plan BLOCK/audit-rejected in runPostPlanActions, plan-container-not-ready in buildPlanContainerOpts) now pass `from: resendCfg.from !== '' ? resendCfg.from : undefined`, so resend.ts:74's onboarding fallback fires exactly when resend_from is unset. Internal helpers widened to carry `from` alongside apiKey/recipient: makeProductionDrainNotifyFn(apiKey, recipient, from, sendFn?), makeProductionEscalateFn(apiKey, recipient, from), makeProductionMetaLoopObserveFn(cwd, logEvent, resendApiKey, resendRecipient, resendFrom, selectFn?) [note: resendFrom is now the 5th positional param, BEFORE selectFn -- two existing test call sites in test/commands/sidecar-meta-loop.test.ts were updated accordingly], and the resendConfig param object types at buildProductionDispatchFn/buildMetaLoopFn now include `from: string`. No behavior change for unconfigured projects (resend_from ''). While gating this story, discovered and root-cause-fixed a newly-surfaced instance of the CAM-201/CAM-226 real-subprocess-default-fn flake class in test/commands/journal-append.test.ts (two --cycle-close tests were missing a fake patternsArchiveFn, occasionally hitting bun's 5000ms default timeout under full-suite contention); fixed by injecting a fake, not a timeout bump. Any downstream story touching Resend further should keep threading `from` the same way.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed emails.send's `from` field accepts "Name <email@example.com>" format, matching the existing sendEscalation default sender string and the resendCfg.from value threaded through in this story; no SDK behavior change needed.
